frontmatter.sidebar_description: Update a cart's applied promotions to add, replace, or remove them.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `updateCartPromotionsWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow updates a cart's promotions, applying or removing promotion codes from the cart. It also computes the adjustments
that need to be applied to the cart's line items and shipping methods based on the promotions applied. This workflow is used by
[Add Promotions Store API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#carts\_postcartsidpromotions).

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows, allowing you to update a cart's promotions within your custom flows.

If you use this workflow in another, you must acquire a lock before running it and release the lock after. Learn more in the [Locking Operations in Workflows](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/locks#locks-in-nested-workflows) guide.

steps.name: acquireLockStep
steps.description:
This step acquires a lock for a given key. Learn more about locks in the [Locking Module](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/infrastructure-modules/locking)
guide.

steps.name: validateCartStep
steps.description:
This step validates a cart to ensure it exists and is not completed.
If not valid, the step throws an error.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/retrieveCartStep) to retrieve a cart's details.

:::

steps.name: validate
steps.description: This hook is executed before all operations. You can consume this hook to perform any custom validation. If validation fails, you can throw an error to stop the workflow execution.

steps.name: setPromotionContext
steps.description: This hook is executed before promotion rules are evaluated for the draft order. You can consume this hook to return any custom context that should be merged on top of the order context when evaluating promotion rules (e.g. `company.id`, `custom_tier`).

steps.name: getPromotionCodesToApply
steps.description: This step retrieves the promotion codes to apply on a cart.

steps.name: getActionsToComputeFromPromotionsStep
steps.description:
This step retrieves the actions to compute based on the promotions
applied on items and shipping methods.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/retrieveCartStep) to retrieve items and shipping methods' details.

:::

steps.name: prepareAdjustmentsFromPromotionActionsStep
steps.description:
This step prepares the line item or shipping method adjustments using
actions computed by the Promotion Module.

steps.name: removeLineItemAdjustmentsStep
steps.description: This step removes line item adjustments from a cart.

steps.name: removeShippingMethodAdjustmentsStep
steps.description: This step removes shipping method adjustments from a cart.

steps.name: createLineItemAdjustmentsStep
steps.description: This step creates line item adjustments in a cart, such as when a promotion is applied.

steps.name: createShippingMethodAdjustmentsStep
steps.description: This step creates shipping method adjustments for a cart.

steps.name: updateCartPromotionsStep
steps.description: This step updates the promotions applied on a cart.

steps.name: refreshPaymentCollectionForCartWorkflow
steps.description: Refresh a cart's payment collection details.

steps.name: releaseLockStep
steps.description:
This step releases a lock for a given key. Learn more about locks in the [Locking Module](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/infrastructure-modules/locking)
guide.

children.name: UpdateCartPromotionsWorkflowInput
children.description: The details of the promotion updates on a cart.

Handlers consuming this hook accept the following input.
